title: PCBWay 6 layer hybrid 1.17 mm: RO4835 4 mil L1-L2, RO4450F 4 mil L2-L3, FR-4 below
vendor_name: Advanced PCB, Rogers 4 series + FR-4 mixed, 6 layers (manual quote)
checkout: Advanced PCB with a Rogers + FR-4 hybrid build; no instant price. Paste the stackup from this file into the quote request and ask the CAM reply to confirm every material and pressed thickness.

thickness_mm.src: derived: sum of the layers below (radar60 plan section 4.1); the CAM reply states the pressed thickness

layers.src: TI-RF (no solder mask over the RF copper; mask elsewhere)
layers.er_prior_src: derived: a typical LPI solder mask

layers.name: F.Cu
layers.src: TI-RF (thin top copper, plated; 0.5 oz base foil plated to about 35 um finished)
layers.foil: RO4835 LoPro reverse-treated foil (Rogers lists ED foil as standard: confirm on the quote)

layers.src: R-4835 (design Dk 3.66, 8-40 GHz; Df 0.0037 at 10 GHz; 4 mil core +/- 0.7 mil)
layers.er_process_src: R-4835 (process Dk of the 4 mil core, 3.33 +/- 0.05)
layers.er_62ghz_prior_src: derived: the radar60 board-calc model value at 62 GHz, between the 4 mil process Dk and the design Dk; G2 measures it
layers.df_62ghz_prior_src: derived: the 10 GHz value carried to 62 GHz (no vendor publishes 60 GHz data); G2 measures it
layers.role: RF layer: launches, feeds and patches on F.Cu over In1.Cu

layers.name: In1.Cu
layers.role: GND, the RF reference; windows cleared under the radiators only (owner decision D4)

layers.er_62ghz_prior_src: derived: the 10 GHz value carried to 62 GHz; G2 measures it
layers.df_62ghz_prior_src: derived: the 10 GHz value carried to 62 GHz; G2 measures it
layers.vendor_note: P-adv lists 'RO4450 0.1mm' as high-frequency prepreg; P-cap lists 4450F for pure Rogers multilayers and Shengyi or RO4403-series prepreg for Rogers + FR-4 mixed builds: confirm the material in a hybrid on the quote
layers.window_composite_src: derived: under an L2 window the bondply also fills the removed 17.5 um of L2 copper, so the patch dielectric is about 0.21-0.22 mm (radar60 review_calc section 1)

layers.name: In2.Cu
layers.role: Solid GND under the RF region (the patch reference under the windows); escape signals elsewhere

layers.src: P-adv (High Tg FR4: S1000-2, S1000-2M, IT180A)
layers.er_prior_src: derived: typical high-Tg FR-4 near 1 GHz; no RF on this layer
layers.df_prior_src: derived: typical high-Tg FR-4 near 1 GHz

layers.name: In3.Cu
layers.src: derived: 1 oz for the 2.5 A peak 1.0 V RF/PA rail (radar60 plan section 4.1)
derived: about 0.10 mm (radar60 plan section 4.1); the CAM reply states the glass style
layers.er_prior_src: derived: typical FR-4 prepreg near 1 GHz
layers.df_prior_src: derived: literature FR-4 near 1 GHz (0.015 to 0.02)

layers.src: P-adv (High Tg FR4: S1000-2, S1000-2M, IT180A)
layers.er_prior_src: derived: typical high-Tg FR-4 near 1 GHz
layers.df_prior_src: derived: typical high-Tg FR-4 near 1 GHz

layers.name: B.Cu
layers.src: derived: 0.5 oz base plated (radar60 plan section 4.1)

layers.er_prior_src: derived: a typical LPI solder mask

tolerances.width_note: P-cap: +/-10 % is the medium-difficulty tier (+/-20 % normal); it is relative to the line width, so the fab notes also ask for an absolute L1 etch tolerance (+/-13 um target, +/-25 um limit) on the RF copper
tolerances.src: P-adv (impedance +/-10 %, board thickness 1.0-2.5 mm +/-7 %) and P-cap (width tolerance tiers)

notes: Draft until the PCBWay quote and CAM reply confirm the materials (RO4835 LoPro foil, RO4450F in an FR-4 hybrid), the pressed thicknesses and the balancing of this asymmetric build.
No solder mask on F.Cu over the RF region (macro-owned mask openings); mask elsewhere on F as usual.
Fallback if RO4450F is not offered in the hybrid: FR-4 prepreg on L2-L3 with the TX feeds kept on 4 mil RO4835 (radar60 plan section 4.1).
